notes.title: Project Skylab 3: A New Frontier is becoming Free-to-Play - PLEASE READ
notes.content:
Hello!

Due to unforeseen developmental and financial circumstances, I have decided to set Project Skylab 3: A New Frontier free-to-play on Steam upon approval from Valve. This decision was NOT taken lightly and greatly debated. Sales of the game have been very lackluster in the paid space. Video games are meant to be played and enjoyed. I kept the price of the game initially low in the possible event of the game not selling well. I am overwhelmingly grateful to the players who purchased my game in the early days, and I am eternally thankful for your belief in my studio and vision for education through gamification. I am a poor college student and the sole developer of this game. My goal is to improve education through gamification, and that’s only going to happen if players play my game. I hope you all can understand my current situation and continue playing Project Skylab 3: A New Frontier. 

Cheers!
Justin
